title: Google\Cloud\AutoMl\V1beta1\ImageObjectDetectionModelDeploymentMetadata
name: ImageObjectDetectionModelDeploymentMetadata
description: Model deployment metadata specific to Image Object Detection.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.node_count
params.description: Input only. The number of nodes to deploy the model on. A node is an abstraction of a machine resource, which can handle online prediction QPS as given in the model's [qps_per_node][google.cloud.automl.v1beta1.ImageObjectDetectionModelMetadata.qps_per_node]. Must be between 1 and 100, inclusive on both ends.
